---
name: Engineering task
about: A focused implementation, fix, or investigation with verifiable completion
title: ''
---

## Goal
Describe the problem and observable outcome.

## Scope
Likely files/components, excluded work, and dependencies. Split independent work that cannot be completed coherently in one session.

## Acceptance checks
- Given ..., when ..., then ...

## Verification
Commands or manual checks and expected results. Identify offline, live-provider, or browser coverage. Include regression tests for behavior changes; documentation-only work may use review instead.

## Completion evidence
Record observed results, remaining limitations, and any durable decision or handoff.
